title: Repository Pattern
description: Abstract data access with a repository layer.

data.text:
**Repository Pattern**

Mediates between the domain and data mapping layers, acting like an in-memory collection of domain objects.

items: Makes unit testing easier with fake repositories
Decouples business logic from EF Core or ADO.NET

data.title: Keep It Simple
data.text: A generic repository adds little over DbSet. Use it when you need testability or shared query logic.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Pair with Unit of Work for transaction management
data.takeaway: Next, we'll coordinate multiple repositories with Unit of Work.
